items.text: Ginza Line Tawaramachi → Ueno (2 stops), then JR Yamanote Line Ueno → Nippori (2 stops). Exit at the north ticket gate.
Guided walking tour 10:30–13:30. Meet 10:20 at JR Nippori north ticket gate, outside, next to the NewDays shop. Ends at Yanaka Ginza.
Lunch near Yanaka Ginza or Nezu, chosen on the spot.

items.label: 📿 Nezu Shrine
items.text: Buy the goshuin book here and get the first stamp.
Walk Nezu Shrine → Tokyo National Museum, via Ueno Sakuragi.
No guide. Last entry 16:30. Hiroshige ticket ¥1,500 includes the collection.
Walk to JR Ueno (10 min), JR Yamanote Line → Kanda (4 min), walk to Kanda Tsukasamachi (~10 min).
Phone only: ask APA reception on Tue 10 to call. ⚠️ One 2026 listing shows lunch only (Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00): if there is no dinner, go to a backup.
Only if dinner is in Asakusa: short evening walk. Gates and pagoda lit, main hall closed.
